title: The pudding cake shop in the food court
content: I don't normally dream about the mall, so I tried hard to have a dream about it last night, and it might have worked. I was in a good court at some place (don't know where, just that it seemed like a good court) and there was a freestanding shop in the middle of a hall that sold pudding cakes. They told me that they were running out of a limited edition flavor called Hippie Dream, so I should try it. It tasted like spice cake and red Kool-aid. They also gave me Kool-aid to drink with it. I wanted to find my spouse to try it too, but couldn't. I had to leave to go do something else, but I don't remember what. They had some other flavors which I also couldn't remember.
